summary: MX2_expand is a 19-line hand-rolled bilinearity chain that duplicates the existing DisKinematics.W2_expand proof verbatim up to renaming; both are instances of one reusable symmetric-bilinear expansion that Mathlib's add_left/add_right make a two-liner.
